ns2:section.sectionText: Leverage your accumulated knowledge with your natural abilities to solve problems for real-world clients. This section will open to BS: Inf Sys & Info Tech - UIUC and BS: Business Process Mgt - UIUC on Monday, November 12, 2018 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This section will open to all other undergraduate Gies College of Business students as well as MS: Finance Cost Rec - UIUC, MBA: (PT) Business Admin - UIUC, MS: Business Administration, MS: Management - UIUC and MBA: Bus Administration - UIUC on Monday, November 19, 2018 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This section will open to Industrial & Enterprise Systems Engineering students on Monday, November 26, 2018 at approximately 10:00 a.m.
